name: Dakota Falls power line ends (A-v6 patch)
_comment: Replaces the last course of each 345 kV circuit (undo the edges in 'replaces' first). The end node carries connectTo {voltage high, radius 60} (bridge 0.9.13) and attaches to the building's high-voltage marker node; its x/z (building centre moved 8 m toward the line) only picks the marker. The start node joins the existing pylon node through snapToSegment (radius 2).
